title: Deco confirms plans to renew Barcelona captain’s contract, expresses shock at Ballon d’Or snub: ‘A global scandal’

He called the Ballon d’Or snub a “global scandal”, noting Pedri’s exclusion and naming Lamine Yamal the likely favourite. As things stand, the club’s next steps on the striker front remain to be seen.

title: Deco reveals why Barcelona kept Anthony Gordon and Rodri transfers secret: ‘Some things that aren’t worth explaining’

title: Deco reveals Real Madrid summer signing wanted Barcelona move: ‘It did not work out because…’
tweet: Barça passed on Bernardo Silva because the role he demanded didn’t fit their plan, not simply because Madrid beat them to him. Silva’s desire for guaranteed minutes and a specific position conflicted with Barça’s criteria, and the club chose to rely on internal talent instead. As things stand, the decision was a strategic one rather than a missed opportunity.

title: Barcelona director backs Lamine Yamal to win the Ballon d’Or: ‘I see no doubt about it’
tweet: Deco says Lamine Yamal is the clear Ballon d’Or candidate and dismisses doubts, while calling Pedri and Raphinha’s exclusion a “global scandal.” As things stand, the award remains up for debate.

title: Barcelona defender putting in extra work to return to his best and win back Flick’s trust
tweet: Kounde has started only two of five games this season, with Eric Garcia now the first‑choice right‑back. He is extending his training days and working with fitness coaches to regain form and Flick’s confidence. As things stand, that effort could restore his place, but nothing is guaranteed.

title: Joao Cancelo insists Barcelona’s Lamine Yamal must win the 2026 Ballon d’Or: ‘There is no other player’
tweet: Joao Cancelo says the only Ballon d’Or candidate is Lamine Yamal, citing 24 goals, 18 assists and a World Cup win at 19. However, the award remains a vote and no single player can be confirmed ahead of the final ballot.

title: Arsenal boss Mikel Arteta emerges as Barcelona’s long-term managerial option
tweet: Barcelona see Arteta as a long‑term successor, but Flick’s contract extension to 2028 shows the club is content for now; the idea is a contingency rather than a threat.

title: Valencia manager hits back at Barcelona’s Rodri over controversial comments: ‘Completely unfortunate’
tweet: Corberan called Rodri’s remarks “completely unfortunate” and dismissed using them for motivation; as things stand, Valencia will look to its own identity and supporters for the spark, not a rival’s comment.

title: Five games, zero minutes – Barcelona youngster finds himself in limbo at club after refusing summer exit
tweet: Balde has stayed on after the summer exit offer, but five La Liga games later he still has 0 minutes; Flick has settled on Espart and Cancelo at left‑back, leaving Balde without a role. Deco insists the player can return if fit, but the reality is that the defender must re‑earn a spot before a January exit becomes likely.

title: Barcelona winger ready to open new contract talks with club – Romano
tweet: Raphinha is set to begin contract talks with Barça, per Fabrizio Romano. As things stand, the club aims to reward his role as striker and captain, but the final terms remain to be seen.
